mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank stimulus and fiscal support, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad demand contraction that triggers market sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output growth below 0.5% year-over-year signals supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as economic deceleration concerns dominate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% yoy, or Rank IC for regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL yoy growth exceeds 3.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Zero-interest-rate policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) limits central bank stimulus capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as stagnation concerns dominate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%, or Rank IC for regime condition is below 0.03.
